attribute_definitions.name: Number of Products To Display
attribute_definitions.description: Enter the number of products to display in the carousel. Default: 6

attribute_definition_groups.name: Product Tile Specifications
attribute_definition_groups.description: Specification of the product to be displayed in the product tile.

attribute_definitions.name: Display product ratings
attribute_definitions.description: Specify whether or not to display ratings in product tile.

attribute_definitions.name: Display product swatches
attribute_definitions.description: Specify whether or not to display swatches in product tile.

attribute_definitions.name: Display Quickview link
attribute_definitions.description: Specify whether or not to display the Quickview link in product tile.

attribute_definitions.name: Container class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to the slider's container for spacing, alignment, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: Slider title class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the title for styling purposes, e.g. 'h2 text--black mb-2'.

attribute_definitions.name: Autoplay
attribute_definitions.description: To turn autoplay on, choose a time in seconds for the delay between slides. Default state is off.

attribute_definitions.name: Disable Loop
attribute_definitions.description: Check this to prevent the slider from looping back to the beginning after the last slide

attribute_definitions.name: Speed
attribute_definitions.description: Enter the number of milliseconds for slide transitions. Default is 300ms.

attribute_definitions.name: Animation
attribute_definitions.description: Choose an animation style. Default is Carousel.

attribute_definitions.name: Pagination Style
attribute_definitions.description: Slider pagination style. Default is dots.

attribute_definitions.name: Pause Button Placement
attribute_definitions.description: Determine where pause button will show on slider, select none for it not to show. NOTE: Showing the button improves on ADA compliance. Only works if autoplay is enabled. Default is none.

attribute_definitions.name: Controls Theme
attribute_definitions.description: Set the theme to help with visibility of the slider's controls. Default is dark

attribute_definition_groups.name: Phone configurations
attribute_definition_groups.description: Configuration for how the slider will display on phones.

attribute_definitions.name: Position slider indicators on the inside of the slider on phones
Position slider controls on the inside of the slider on phones
Number of slides to display on phones
attribute_definitions.description: Default is 1 slide visible at a time.

attribute_definitions.name: Space between slides
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number representing how many pixels there should be between slides. Default is 20.

attribute_definitions.name: Show percentage of previous slide
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a percentage below to show a portion of the previous slide to the left. Default is 0%.

attribute_definitions.name: Show percentage of next slide
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a percentage below to show a portion of the next slide to the right. Default is 0%.
